title: Budget reservation/settlement test fails (expected aiUsageCurrent 0.28, received 0.45)
impact: `npm run test:security` exits non-zero (1 failed / 33 passed; raw/test-security.txt). Either settlement/reservation accounting double-counts (metering correctness bug, money-relevant) or the test constant is stale. The failure is invisible because nothing runs this suite automatically.
recommendation: Debug settleBudget with the failing inputs (reserve twice, settle twice with 1000/1000 tokens): decide if 0.45 is a double-settle bug or a stale expectation; fix the code or the test and keep the test as regression guard.

title: Due-date test exercises a function copy-pasted into the test file, not production code
impact: The test defines `isSubmissionLate` locally (L2-L10) and imports nothing from src/. Any change or bug in the real due-date enforcement cannot fail this test; it gives false assurance for a critical path.
recommendation: Extract the production predicate into src/lib (or import the real server check in src/app/api/submissions/route.ts) and test that; add cases for Firestore Timestamp, ISO string, invalid string (NaN), and exact-equal boundary.

title: Plan-limit test asserts a locally re-declared isWaypointLocked, not the real implementation
impact: `isWaypointLocked` is defined inside the describe block; no production import. Free-plan gating (revenue-relevant) is therefore untested, and drift between UI code and test goes unnoticed.
recommendation: Move the predicate to src/lib/plan-limits.ts, import it in both the page and the test; add a server-side enforcement test for free-plan limits.

title: Polar webhook test mocks signature validation, so the signature-verification path is untested
impact: `jest.mock('@polar-sh/sdk/webhooks', () => ({validateEvent: body => JSON.parse(body)}))` bypasses validateEvent. No test covers a bad/missing signature (expect 401/403), missing webhook-id, malformed JSON, or unknown event types. Only 2 tests (L11, L19).
recommendation: Add tests where validateEvent throws WebhookVerificationError and assert 403 and no Firestore writes; add subscription.canceled/revoked/past_due cases.

title: Cloud Functions have effectively no tests (grading, billing, email triggers untested)
impact: Coverage for functions/src is 17.77% lines / 1.51% branches, only metering.ts is touched (raw/jest.txt); grading.ts, billing.ts, index.ts have no test file and functions/package.json has no test script. Known High bugs in this code (K-001, K-002) would have been caught by trigger-level tests.
recommendation: Add a functions test setup (firebase-functions-test or Firestore emulator + direct handler invocation) covering onSubmissionCreated/Updated lock lease, partial failure, idempotency, and metering.

title: AI grading logic only ~45% covered; score clamping, rubric handling and usage metadata paths untested
impact: jest.txt: grading.ts 44.61% lines / 34.56% branches, uncovered 130-163,173-197; ai/utils.ts 10.22% lines (41-208). Existing 4 tests (__tests__/grading-failure.test.ts:L6-L9) only cover failure/parse behavior of one function.
recommendation: Add table-driven tests: score > maxPoints clamped, negative, NaN, string scores, per-question rubric partial credit, usage token accounting, prompt-injection answer text does not alter schema.

title: Usage/plan limit, class enrollment, assignment parser and Polar helper have zero unit tests
impact: No test imports src/lib/usage-limit.ts, class-enrollment.ts, assignment-parser.ts, assignment-points.ts, polar.ts, onboarding-links.ts (checked via file listing and jest.txt coverage rows, none listed). Only 2 of 29 API routes (auth/session, chat/landing) have route-level unit tests; others only via emulator workflow tests.
recommendation: Prioritise usage-limit and class-enrollment tests (see E7 list); add route tests for /api/grade, /api/submissions, /api/checkout, /api/student/tutor.

title: Rate limiter has no dedicated tests (64% lines, 50% branches by incidental coverage)
impact: Uncovered lines 26,44-46,52-53,57-58,71-73 (raw/jest.txt) include window expiry and eviction. Rate limiting is an abuse/cost control for AI endpoints.
recommendation: Add tests with jest.useFakeTimers: N+1th call blocked, window reset, per-key isolation, memory eviction.

title: No component, hook or E2E tests; only node-environment tests exist
impact: testEnvironment is 'node'; no @testing-library/react, jsdom, Playwright or Cypress in package.json. fallow-health reports 215 untested files, 14.3% file coverage. 45 pages and critical flows (login, assignment submit, grading UI) have no UI-level regression net; hotspot files (student/tutor/page.tsx, assignment-view/page.tsx) are untested.
recommendation: Add jsdom + React Testing Library for the 5 hotspot components, and 3 Playwright smoke flows against emulators (login, submit assignment, teacher grade).

title: Security/emulator suites are not part of `npm test` and there is no CI, so failures go unnoticed
impact: jest.config.js:L8-ish testPathIgnorePatterns excludes /tests/security/; `npm test` passes (39/39) while `npm run test:security` fails. Firestore rules, workflow and webhook tests are the strongest tests in the repo yet run only manually.
recommendation: Add a CI job running `npm run test:security` (see L-001) and a `test:all` script.

title: ts-jest 29 paired with jest 30
impact: jest ^30.2.0 (L109) with ts-jest ^29.4.6 (L112): outside the official peer range (ts-jest 29 supports jest 29). Suites pass today, but upgrades can break silently; there is also no `isolatedModules`/swc config so TS type-checks every test run.
recommendation: Upgrade to ts-jest 30 (or move to @swc/jest / next/jest) and pin matching majors.

title: Unit test co-located in src/ while all others are in __tests__/
impact: Inconsistent test layout (9 files in __tests__/, 1 in src/lib/); also, testPathIgnorePatterns lacks `.next/standalone`, so jest-haste-map reports duplicate-package-name collisions (raw/test-security.txt L19-L28) from .next/standalone/source/learn/scorpio.
recommendation: Choose one convention (recommend __tests__/); add `modulePathIgnorePatterns: ['<rootDir>/.next/']` to both jest configs (jest.config.js, jest.security.config.cjs).

title: 833-line, 9-step order-dependent end-to-end test sharing mutable state; dense single-line tests elsewhere
impact: Tests 1..9 depend on state created by prior tests (a failure in step 2 cascades to 3-9, masking root cause). Several security tests are written as very dense single-line statements (e.g. workflows.test.ts:L60), hurting failure diagnosis and review.
recommendation: Split into independently seeded scenarios with helper factories; run prettier on tests.

title: Positive: authz tests assert denial paths and fail closed
impact: Tests cover missing credentials, invalid bearer, impersonation (uid mismatch), revocation checks, role-forgery cookie, teacher-only guard with `handler not called`. rules.test.cjs (72 lines) covers cross-school reads, forged grading fields, key/legacy-doc secrecy, storage cross-student denial. No network calls; no real timers except emulator usage.
recommendation: Keep this style; extend the same negative-case pattern to /api/grade and /api/submissions.

title: E6 mutation testing not run
impact: Stryker is not installed and installing it would modify package.json/node_modules (violates read-only rule); no results fabricated. Given the 100% line coverage on assignment-validation.ts but only 92% branches (lines 21,31 uncovered), mutation score likely moderate.
recommendation: Run `npx stryker run` in a scratch clone after the tests above are added.

title: withAuthorizedRequest has a 21.85% mutation score (24 survived, 94 no-coverage); resource ownership, 500 KB cap and grading-lock paths lack unit tests
impact: Stryker (raw/stryker-report.json) shows 94 NoCoverage mutants in src/lib/auth-verify.ts:L49-L99 (submission/portfolio ownership checks, grading_locks transaction, catch block) and 24 Survived mutants in L9-L80 (including L40 Buffer.byteLength(raw) > 500000 -> false/>=, L46 profile.role !== 'teacher' -> true, L74 !effectiveOrgId && profile.teacherId -> true, and L24 verifyCallerIdentity positive path). Unit tests in __tests__/auth-verify.test.ts would not catch regressions in payload-size DoS protection, teacher positive authz, org inheritance, or grading locks.
recommendation: Add unit tests in __tests__/auth-verify.test.ts covering 500,000 vs 500,001 byte bodies (413), teacher positive path (200), submission/portfolio ownership allow/deny and grading-lock 409/200 paths, student teacher.organizationId inheritance in billingContext, and verifyCallerIdentity positive return.

title: 6 mutants (3 survived, 3 no-coverage) in validateQuestionAnswers expose untested whitespace-option and 'False' true/false branches
impact: Despite 100% line coverage, Stryker (raw/stryker-report.json) achieved 88.00% total mutation score (44 killed, 3 survived, 3 no-coverage): L21 opt.trim() -> opt survived, L31 !q.correctAnswer || ... -> && and false survived (negative test only passes empty string ''), and L31 q.correctAnswer !== 'False' had 3 NoCoverage mutants because no test passes correctAnswer: 'False'.
recommendation: Add 3 test cases to __tests__/assignment-validation.test.ts: (1) true-false with correctAnswer: 'False' (valid), (2) true-false with correctAnswer: 'Maybe' (invalid), and (3) multiple-choice with whitespace-only option matching correctAnswer: '   ' (invalid).
